name: Dimension Door
description:
You teleport yourself from your current location to any other location within 500 ft of you. It can be a place you can see, a place you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction. You can bring along any objects you're carrying, as well as one other willing creature that you are touching.

Roll Lore to determine any additional effects. If the destination is a location you cannot see, the roll is ill-favored.

Describe how you teleport.
successes:
✨: You get a momentary, silent vision of the destination as you cast the spell. You may choose to abort the spell, regaining half of its MP cost if you do.

🌞: After you teleport, for the next minute, you may spend an action to teleport back to your original location.

💀: You miscalculate and arrive in a space already occupied by an object or creature. You and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 damage, are returned to your original location, and are knocked prone. You each check a Condition.
